schema.text: Without a car, do you give up trying or find it very hard to take bulky or hazardous waste to a collection point?

ar.#Without a car, do you give up trying or: بدون سيارة، هل تتخلى عن المحاولة أو تجد صعوبة بالغة في نقل نفايات كبيرة أو خطرة إلى نقطة تجميع؟

de.#Without a car, do you give up trying or: Verzichten Sie ohne Auto darauf oder fällt es Ihnen sehr schwer, Sperrmüll oder Sondermüll zu einer Sammelstelle zu bringen?

en.#Without a car, do you give up trying or: Without a car, do you give up trying or find it very hard to take bulky or hazardous waste to a collection point?

fa.#Without a car, do you give up trying or: بدون خودرو، آیا از تلاش دست می‌کشید یا برایتان خیلی سخت است که زباله حجیم یا خطرناک را به محل جمع‌آوری ببرید؟

fr.#Without a car, do you give up trying or: Sans voiture, renoncez-vous à essayer ou trouvez-vous très difficile de apporter des déchets encombrants ou dangereux à un point de collecte ?

hu.#Without a car, do you give up trying or: Autó nélkül lemond arról, vagy nagyon nehéznek találja, hogy terjedelmes vagy veszélyes hulladékot elvinni a gyűjtőhelyre?

it.#Without a car, do you give up trying or: Senza auto, rinunci o fai molta fatica a portare rifiuti ingombranti o pericolosi a un punto di raccolta?

tr.#Without a car, do you give up trying or: Arabanız olmadan, hacimli veya tehlikeli atıkları toplama noktasına götürmekten vazgeçiyor veya bunu çok zor buluyor musunuz?
